services.name: kayaking in Seward
services.desc: This is an adventurous trip. It is very fun, but it operates outdoors, so you should be prepared to paddle in all types of weather. Participants should be comfortable spending several hours actively paddling in a kayak, and with riding in a water taxi for several hours on open seas. Another summer season is around the bend, and with it Liquid Adventures is proud to offer another first for clients who want to explore Kenai Fjords National Park by kayak. Having an exclusive partnership with AK Fjords Marine Service, whose captain and crew operates the private water taxi allows us the flexibility to choose the remote glacial landscape that we paddle in for the day.
